source_checks: Launcher validates explicit CPU indices against inherited allowed mask, sets parent affinity and Idle before spawning, verifies settings, and restores original affinity/priority/thread environment in nested finally blocks.
Probe creation explicitly supplies IDLE_PRIORITY_CLASS and CREATE_NO_WINDOW on Windows; inherited CPU affinity is the documented runbook assumption, not a runtime-verified result.

Native Windows CPU timing and Python post-exit GetProcessTimes both combine high and low FILETIME words; native values convert 100-nanosecond ticks to nanoseconds and parent values convert to seconds.
Relabel Windows total CPU uses parent process CPU plus all owned child totals after pool close; unavailable child totals remain null and explicitly unverified.

Build uses explicit GCC-compatible compiler, strict floating-point flags, all current FORGE options OFF, one requested build job by default, source hashes before and after, and whole-executable FMA disassembly checks.
Windows runbook uses PowerShell 7 arrays for native arguments, absolute paths, new GUID output/log directories, explicit MSYS2 UCRT64 tools, and documented no-hard-memory-cap limitation.
Bundle checker normalizes Windows separators before mapping process receipt paths and file coverage; source writer backslash path formatting is supported.
limitations: No PowerShell or Windows execution was available; this review cannot qualify the wrapper, MinGW build, process inheritance, or Windows throughput.
No new native searches, builds, test suites, benchmarks, or active filter modifications were performed.
No claim that unusual external-child behavior beyond the fixed native protocol is exhaustively covered.
